timers.text: The Today HTTP response is `no-store`; shared server day reads are at most 15 seconds old for Today and coalesce concurrent requests. Other views retain their prior cache. Polls pause for hidden tabs/offscreen frames/offline/pagehide and resume when active. Errors back off (60 seconds initially, up to 5 minutes, honoring bounded Retry-After). Individual browser refresh requests time out after 12 seconds and never overlap. No API tokens or imports are involved. This is periodic source refresh, not a WebSocket feed; displayed changes depend on the HMS scorer's updates.

- `docs/GAME-CENTER.md`: Game Summary v1, finished-only importer and game-report contract, transactional snapshot and event history; today/live polling documented as pause-on-hidden/offline and exponential backoff.
